title: Homeowner's Insurance Requirement and Lender-Placed Coverage for Rural Home Loans
content:
**Standard.** A home financed with a Rural Home Loans loan must be insured against fire and extended perils for at least the lesser of its replacement cost and the principal balance, with the association named mortgagee. A new declarations page is recorded with its expiry date as printed; the member's word is not proof. When the record shows no coverage after the expiry date, the member is sent a first notice and, at least 15 days before placement, a second notice; if proof is not received by the end of the product's lender-placed notice days after the first notice, the association places coverage and assesses its premium, the product's lender-placed premium percentage of the principal balance for one year, booked as a lender-placed insurance fee. Proof of coverage with no gap received later waives the premium as an error correction. Where escrow is not waived, premiums of the member's own policy are paid from escrow under the escrow disbursement rule.

## Evidence

The expiry date relied on is the one printed on the latest declarations page recorded; a member's statement that coverage was renewed is not proof until a declarations page is recorded.

## Sequence of notices

| Point | Event |
|---|---|
| after the recorded expiry date with no coverage on record | first notice |
| at least 15 days before placement | second notice |
| end of the lender-placed notice days after the first notice, no proof received | coverage placed, premium assessed |
| later proof of coverage with no gap | premium waived as an error correction |

## Worked figure (hypothetical inputs)

At a lender-placed premium of 1.85 percent and a principal balance of 160000.00 USD at placement, the premium for one year is 160000.00 multiplied by 1.85 and divided by 100, that is 2960.00 USD.
